teaser: A reply to Bert Kok: agents that augment journalists, publishers that own the now cheap stack, and the reader's trust above all.
core_idea: Bert Kok is right that AI platforms now own synthesis and the interface while publishers fund costly discovery; the knowledge architecture and reader feedback loop the essay calls for already exist in our open-source stack, where agents augment rather than replace journalists, so publishers should own that cheap stack and, above all, the reader's trust.
